skill.name: uspto-database
skill.description: Search USPTO patent and trademark data through PatentSearch, PEDS, TSDR, assignment, citation, office action, PTAB, and litigation references.
skill.summary: Use USPTO APIs to research patents, trademarks, prosecution history, ownership, and prior art.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: AI review found no malicious intent or prompt injection in the skill files. Most high secret-key detections are placeholders or explicit USPTO API parameters; the remaining risks are intended external API requests and command-line handling of a user API key.

remediation.suggestion: Prefer USPTO_API_KEY environment variables or a secret store, and warn users not to pass keys through argv.
Document contacted domains, require user intent before live requests, and add request timeouts and retry limits.
Keep placeholders clearly non-secret and tell users not to paste real keys into prompts or committed files.

content.user_title: Search USPTO Patent and Trademark Data
content.value_statement: Patent and trademark research often requires several USPTO data sources. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused workflows for USPTO API research.
actual_capabilities: Search granted patents by keywords, inventor, assignee, CPC class, and date range.
Retrieve patent details, abstracts, classifications, inventors, assignees, and citation fields.
Access PEDS examination status, transaction history, office action events, and prosecution summaries.
Look up trademark status, owners, goods and services, and prosecution history through TSDR.
Use examples for assignments, citations, litigation, PTAB, and office action data.
Run included Python helper scripts when required API keys and dependencies are available.
limitations: Protected endpoints require USPTO or PatentsView API keys.
API coverage, field names, and rate limits can change outside the skill.
The PEDS helper depends on the external uspto-opendata-python package.
The skill supports research but does not provide legal advice.

use_cases.title: Build Prior Art Searches
use_cases.description: Find patents by technology terms, assignees, inventors, dates, and CPC classes for early prior art review.

use_cases.title: Check Trademark Status
use_cases.description: Review trademark status, owners, goods and services, and prosecution events before brand decisions.

use_cases.title: Review Prosecution History
use_cases.description: Combine PEDS status, transaction history, office actions, assignments, and citations for a case timeline.

prompt_templates.title: Search by Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search USPTO patent data for patents about [technology topic]. Focus on recent grants and summarize the main assignees.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Patent
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up patent [patent number]. Summarize the title, abstract, assignees, inventors, filing details, and cited patents.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Trademark
prompt_templates.prompt: Check trademark serial number [serial number]. Report current status, owner, goods and services, and notable prosecution events.

prompt_templates.title: Create an IP Portfolio Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the patent and trademark portfolio for [company]. Combine search results, assignments, prosecution status, citations, and notable risks.

output_examples.input: Search patents about solid state battery electrolytes from 2022 onward.
output_examples.output: A concise research brief with matching patents, leading assignees, filing trends, CPC classes, and candidate records for deeper review.
A status summary with mark text, owner information, filing status, goods and services, registration data, and prosecution highlights.
A timeline of PEDS transactions with office actions, responses, current status, pendency, and important examination events.

best_practices: Store API keys in environment variables or approved secret stores.
Request only the fields needed for the research task.
Cache repeated public records and respect USPTO rate limits.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real API keys into shared prompts or committed files.
Do not treat API search output as legal advice without expert review.
Do not run broad searches without date, field, or classification limits.

faq.question: Which USPTO data sources does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers PatentSearch, PEDS, TSDR, assignment APIs, citation data, office action data, litigation records, and PTAB references.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Several USPTO and PatentsView endpoints require an API key before live requests can run.

faq.question: Can it search trademarks?
faq.answer: Yes. The included trademark client supports serial number and registration number lookups through TSDR.

faq.question: Can it retrieve prosecution history?
faq.answer: Yes. The PEDS helper is designed for application status, transaction history, office actions, and prosecution summaries.

faq.question: Is this a legal advice tool?
faq.answer: No. It organizes public USPTO data for research and should be reviewed by a qualified professional.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
